Name: JojaSweets Candy
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][quote]Delight your senses with [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaSweets[/b][/color]![/quote][/size]
JojaMart’s candy racks now stock [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaSweet[/b][/color]™ candies! 
[b]
The two candy stands at the checkout counters are now shops!
[/b]
• 5 regular [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaSweet [/b][/color]candies with no buffs.
﻿- A little energy boost at a low-ish cost

• 16 unique [color=#6d9eeb][b]Seasonal [/b][/color]candies, 4 per season that are only sold during that season
﻿- Each give a short skill buff[b]
[b][b] ﻿[/b][/b][/b]- [b]Custom [color=#6d9eeb]JojaSweets [/color]buff IDs[/b]. Meaning [b]these do not take up a [b]traditional [/b]food buff slot[/b]. They'll only overwrite other[b] [color=#6d9eeb]JojaSweets [/color]buffs[/b]!

They're neutral gifts, so don't forget to share!

Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38939]JojaMills Breakfast[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more Joja snacks!

There's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields, or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url] if you'd like a side job!

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore

Doesn't edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't remove/relocate the checkout counters.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch., VPR-Inspired UI, Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic)
